column1: # Galaxy Map Normandy strings, English. One line per string: id, a tab, the text (UTF-8). build.sh makes the mod's
# GlobalTlk packages from src/tlk/<language>.tsv; every language must have the same ids. In 74220028 and 74220029,
# {0} is the number: write a percent as the game does in that language. French puts a no-break space (U+00A0) before %.
# Never use U+202F (narrow no-break space): the game's fonts lack it.

column2: How fast the ship flies at cluster level, with the controller and with the mouse. The map cursor, and so what is selected, moves at the same speed.
How fast the ship's nose turns toward where it flies at cluster level.
How closely the ship follows the map cursor at cluster level. Lower values let it glide behind; higher values keep it on the cursor.
Size of the ship at cluster level.
How fast the ship flies in system view, with the controller and with the mouse. The camera follows the ship there, so the view moves faster too.
How fast the ship's nose turns toward where it flies in system view.
How closely the ship follows the map cursor in system view. Lower values let it glide behind; higher values keep it on the cursor.
Size of the ship in system view.
Sets every setting on this page back to its default.
Changes show the next time the map opens.

column1: # 74220020 held "(default)" in v1.3 and earlier. 74220029 holds that word now, with its number. The id is retired:
# no file has it, and no new string may take it.

column2: Flight speed, turn rate, response and size of the ship on the galaxy map, at cluster level and in system view, the volume of its flight sound, and the mass relay movie. The same for every save.
How loud the ship's flight sound is on the galaxy map, at both levels: the whoosh, the engine and the drive. 0% turns it off.
